# Theme brief: New Door Investments

Page: `/web-design/new-door/`. Tokens are in that page's `style.css`.

- Colors: near-black `#0A0A0A` and `#171717`, grey `#5C5C5C`, soft greys `#F8F8F8` and `#EBEBEB`, slate `#A7AFBF`.
  Accents: muted blue `#78AFCF` (shapes only, fails AA as text), link blue `#0A6AA6` (the live `#0099FF` fails AA on white).
  Hero is a lavender twilight photo.
- Fonts: Inter Display 500 for headings (Inter on Google Fonts with the `opsz` axis at 32), Inter for body. A little Manrope on the live site; skip it.
- Logo: `img/logo.webp` ("ND" door mark, line art on white). The full logo is in the client repo (public/newdoor-logo.png), not copied.
- Motifs: glass buildings with fog at the bottom edge, white rounded cards with slate icons, small uppercase blue
  labels, black pill-shaped button, 3D architecture render. Calm and premium.
- Motion ideas:
  - A door opens on page entry, revealing the hero (ties to the name).
  - Fog drifts slowly across the bottom of the hero.
  - Case study land plats fade from outline to filled as you scroll (plats are in the client repo, not copied).
  - Slow, smooth fades. Nothing bouncy.
- Images in `img/`: hero, inventory, services, expertise, thumb, logo.
- Do not use: the team photo in the client repo (a person), or the "Three ways to put [founder] in your corner" section (names a person).
